rules.condition: i_wr_en = 1 while the FIFO is full (write domain)
rules.statement: The FIFO must pulse o_overflow for one cycle, registered, in the cycle after a rejected write request when i_wr_en = 1 while full.
The write must be dropped: storage and write pointer remain unchanged.
o_overflow must self-clear after one cycle and must be cleared by i_rst_n_wr.

rules.condition: i_rd_en = 1 while the FIFO is empty (read domain)
rules.statement: The FIFO must pulse o_underflow for one cycle, registered, in the cycle after a rejected read request when i_rd_en = 1 while empty.
The read pointer must remain unchanged and o_rd_data must still show the word at the read pointer.
o_underflow must self-clear after one cycle and must be cleared by i_rst_n_rd.
The integrator must reset both domains; reset asserted in one domain only leaves inconsistent FIFO state that the IP does not detect.
The IP does not detect illegal parameters and behavior is undefined; the configuration must be fixed, so illegal parameters must not be used.

rules.condition: i_wr_en or i_rd_en = 1 while blocked by a software reset
rules.statement: The access must not be accepted and no o_overflow or o_underflow pulse must be generated.

rules.condition: i_rst_n_sw = 0 while a software reset is already in progress
rules.statement: The new i_rst_n_sw request must be ignored until the write FSM is back in RUN; a new sequence then starts if i_rst_n_sw is still 0.
The o_overflow and o_underflow flags belong to different domains and must not interact.

rules.condition: Simultaneous write and read in the same cycle
rules.statement: A simultaneous write and read on the same cycle must not produce both o_overflow and o_underflow for the same event.
No retry or drain is provided by the FIFO; the producer or consumer must react to the o_overflow and o_underflow flags.
